[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]How to Install[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3](Optional) Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ so that you can edit options while in the game.[/size][/font]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Download this mod from the files tab, extract it, and place it into your Mods folder. (If updating, delete the old version of the mod. Do not just overwrite it.)[/font][/size]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Run the game and enjoy![/size][/font]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Config Options[/b][/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Title Card Options [/b]- Choose between plain, floral and more floral. (This is currently not available for the Chinese version of the logo.) See the first three pictures in Images for examples (reverse order). The backgrounds are edited by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416]Custom Menu Background.[/url][/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Tab Overlay[/b] - Changing this to disabled will remove the vine and flowers on the menu tabs. Some can find them to be cluttered with the vines. Please note that any compatibility patches I provide in the optional files will not have vines on them.[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Farmer Portrait[/b] - Choose between pixel, realistic, or disabled. See the Images for an example between pixel and realistic. Disabling this will allow you to use another portrait mod you prefer without conflict.[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Cursor Toggle[/b] - Turning the provided pointers off will allow you to use another mod that replaces the cursors. [/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Heart Icons[/b] - Turning this off will allow you to use another mod that replaces the relationship icons. There are a lot of options out there![/size][/font]

[color=#f4cccc][size=5]Optional Files[/size][/color]
[/b][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Overgrown Flowery Digspots [/b]- These are the little wiggly flowers that used to be packaged with the main mod. They're very cute, but not technically a UI feature. I removed them from the main mod to prevent conflicts with other dig spot mods.[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Overgrown Flowery Compatibility[/b] - Installed a mod that added a UI feature and now everything doesn't match? I try to make as many patches as I'm able and allowed to and collect them here. To use these, copy the files over the assets in the other mod.
[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Overgrown Flowery Pointers [/b]- These are just the little pointers that are already included with the main mod. Maraluna put out her old cursors  - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6132]Overgrown Flowery Cursors[/url]﻿ - a few years ago, but never included these. So, by request, I've made them available as a stand-alone mod for those who wish to use another UI.[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Overgrown Flowery Overlays[/b] - Just the bits of vines and flowers to use with another UI mod. I particularly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13694]Starry Blue UI[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url]﻿ as pairings. They look amazing with these overlays.[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Small Font Patch[/b] - [font=Georgia][size=3]tldr; Install it if you use a Latin-letter font, want lighter colors, and don't want to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]﻿.[/size][/font] ----- The small and medium font that the game uses has always been hardcoded into an XNB file (aka a modding nightmare). Back in the dark ages before we had other languages and thus other fonts in the game to support them, we could recolor this file, repackage it as an xnb, and include it in Content Patcher to change the horrid maroon and orange coloring.  It's not possible to do this anymore so this same set of xnb files that lightly desaturate the base font is passed around from UI mod to UI mod. Having it installed by default though overwrites literally any other language that isn't using a Latin-based alphabet and is a huge hassle for those people - so I separated it for those that must have it.[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]﻿
[/size][/font][/list][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Make sure all your mods, especially this one, are up to date.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Make a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]﻿ to see if anything sticks out. Here is a guide about reading logs on the [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Tutorial:_How_to_read_your_SMAPI_log]SDV Modding Wiki[/url]﻿.﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Reach out to me by making a bug report with your SMAPI log.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Ask in the #modded-game-support channel of the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]SDV Discord Server[/url].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]If you've been able to pinpoint a particular mod that's causing a conflict, consider learning how to set up a false dependency. Here is a [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Tutorial:_How_to_Add_a_False_Dependency_for_Load_Orders]guide[/url]﻿.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]If you're using a mod manager, try to install the mod without it. I only recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿ for managing Stardew Valley mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Where is Kitty Channels? You can find a link to the original mod and the update below in the Recommended section.[/size][/font]

Downloads.Description:
Just the flowery accents for the billboard, calendar, clock, portraits, buttons, and tabs. All options are configurable to use with your favorite UI mod.

Added all the UI mods I could think of as false dependencies so this will work correctly.

Manifest.Description: The vines and petals from Overgrown Flowery Interface laid over your favorite UI mod.
